message.heliosphere.power_no_air: no atmosphere: a wind turbine needs air
message.heliosphere.power_sheltered: sheltered: put it up high with 2 blocks of open air around it
message.heliosphere.power_no_heat: no lava or magma within 4 blocks below
message.heliosphere.power_no_coolant: no coolant: the reactor needs water next to it
message.heliosphere.power_no_fuel: out of fuel: right-click with fuel to load it
message.heliosphere.power_battery_status: %s · stored %s FE (%s%%) · output up to %s FE/t
message.heliosphere.habitat_on: Field up: a circle of radius %s round the emitter, from %s blocks below to %s above, with breathable air, 20°C and Earth gravity. Charge %s FE, using %s FE/t.
item.heliosphere.bio_capsule.hint: Right-click a creature to take it in (health, name, age, collar and all), then right-click the ground to let it out. Players, bosses and machines cannot be taken.
item.heliosphere.bio_capsule.release: Right-click the ground to let it out
message.heliosphere.bio_capsule_full: The capsule already holds a creature: let it out first
message.heliosphere.bio_capsule_refused: That cannot be taken (no players, bosses or machines)
message.heliosphere.bio_capsule_no_air: Careful: there is no breathable air here and Earth creatures slowly suffocate - let it out inside a habitat field.
item.heliosphere.laoba_lunch.hint: Made of leaves. 3 haunches of food, but you will feel sick, hungrier and wobbly for a while.
item.heliosphere.sprint_gel.hint: Sugar and honey in a squeeze pouch. One mouthful and you run flat out for minutes.
item.heliosphere.miner_stew.hint: A tin of beef, potato and carrot. Your pick and axe work noticeably faster afterwards.
item.heliosphere.myofiber_steak.hint: Beef fibre re-laid by the synthesizer. Your fists and blades hit harder.
item.heliosphere.regen_broth.hint: Chicken broth with two mushrooms. Drink it hot and your wounds close by themselves.
item.heliosphere.bulwark_ration.hint: Space rations and pork pressed into a brick. Blows hurt a good deal less after it.
item.heliosphere.cryo_jelly.hint: Jelly set with lunar ice. The chill goes right through you: lava and fire cannot burn you.
item.heliosphere.owl_juice.hint: Carrot and glow berry concentrate. Night and caves turn as clear as day.
item.heliosphere.kelp_sushi.hint: Salmon rolled in kelp. Breathe freely under water, in the sea or under the ice.
item.heliosphere.bounce_jelly.hint: Springy sweets of slime gel. You jump several blocks high.
item.heliosphere.hydrogen_meringue.hint: Meringue whipped with hydrogen, light enough to float. You drift down from any height. The canister comes back empty.
item.heliosphere.shield_shake.hint: Milk, cocoa and egg. Gives you a layer of extra health on top of your own. The bucket comes back.
item.heliosphere.vital_pudding.hint: Honey, melon and egg custard. Four more hearts of maximum health.
item.heliosphere.fortune_cookie.hint: The slip inside reads: "A good day for chests and fishing." Luck is with you.
item.heliosphere.nutrient_capsule.hint: A whole meal in a pill: swallowed in a moment, it fills your hunger at once, even in a fight.
item.heliosphere.captain_feast.hint: A whole table seasoned with tholin, Europan salt and lunar ice: strength, speed, haste, resistance, extra health and regeneration at once.
tooltip.heliosphere.starch_made: Made from starch: one shank less food than the real thing
condition.heliosphere.co2_air: Needs the open sky of Mars or Venus
condition.heliosphere.open_air: Needs air and the open sky
message.heliosphere.capsule_you_are_held: %s put you in a bio capsule: you can look around but cannot move or touch anything (chat still works)
message.heliosphere.capsule_you_are_free: You are out of the bio capsule
tooltip.heliosphere.tunnel_borer.hint: Right-click the ground to set it down (needs a clear 3×3×3 space). Then right-click to ride it, sneak + right-click for the control panel, sneak + left-click to pack it up.
tooltip.heliosphere.tunnel_borer.stored: Bin: %s items · Charge: %s FE · Bored: %s blocks
screen.heliosphere.borer.title: Tunnel Borer Control Panel
screen.heliosphere.borer.fuel: Fuel in the bin: %s (burned automatically when the charge runs low)
screen.heliosphere.borer.tip.auto: Bores the set distance along the current heading and slope on its own; it carries on with nobody aboard and keeps its chunks loaded meanwhile.
screen.heliosphere.borer.tip.lining: Sets lining segments into gaps in the tunnel walls, roof and floor (each uses 1 waste rock from the bin); water and lava are always sealed off.
screen.heliosphere.borer.tip.veins: At every block bored, scans for ore within 2 blocks of the tunnel and mines the whole vein into the bin.
screen.heliosphere.borer.tip.lights: Sets a lamp segment into the tunnel roof every 6 blocks.
screen.heliosphere.borer.tip.junk: Throws away stone, cobblestone, deepslate, dirt, gravel and the like, keeping only 64 as lining material.
screen.heliosphere.borer.tip.pack: Packs it into an item; the bin's contents and the charge are kept.
status.heliosphere.borer.no_energy: Out of power: put coal, wood or other fuel in the bin
status.heliosphere.borer.obstructed: A player is in the way
status.heliosphere.borer.world_limit: Reached the edge of the world
message.heliosphere.borer.no_space: Not enough room: the tunnel borer needs a clear 3×3×3 space
message.heliosphere.borer.packed: Tunnel borer packed up (its %s bin items are kept with it)
message.heliosphere.borer.not_owner: Only the player who set this tunnel borer down can pack it up
hud.heliosphere.borer.keys: W bore · S reverse · A/D turn · Space+W up · Ctrl+W down · %s auto · E panel · Shift exit
message.heliosphere.habitat_unpowered: The field has no power: connect the emitter to the grid with a cable (it uses %s FE/t while running). Charge %s FE.
